implementation_summary: F-032: deploy.yml runner --set-env-vars now uses gcloud's ^@^ alternate delimiter so RUNNER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS keeps both comma-separated origins as one value; same 9 variables and values, plus a comment explaining the delimiter. The test now splits the flag value the way gcloud does (^DELIM^ prefix, trailing delimiter, KEY=value split on the first '='). It checks the parser against the old comma-only line, requires every item to be KEY=value with unique keys, requires RUNNER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS to hold both origins as one value, requires the four audit/Firebase variables as $NAME, and checks the existing RUNNER_* values exactly. No assertion was weakened. docs/DEPLOYMENT.md does not show the command, so it is unchanged.
